| **English: ** "[The Blue Marble](mw:File/Thumb "background")" is a famous photograph of the Earth taken on December 7, 1972, by the crew of the [Apollo 17](mw:File/Thumb "background") spacecraft en route to the Moon at a distance of about 29,400 kilometres (18,300 mi). It shows [Africa](mw:File/Thumb "background"), [Antarctica](mw:File/Thumb "background"), and the [Arabian Peninsula](mw:File/Thumb "background"). | **Français : ** «[La bille bleue](mw:File/Thumb "background")» : Photo de l'Afrique, de l'Antarctique et de la péninsule Arabique prise en route pour la lune par [Harrison Schmitt](mw:File/Thumb "background") ou [Ron Evans](mw:File/Thumb "background") lors de la mission [Apollo 17](mw:File/Thumb "background") le 7 décembre 1972. Ce vol a été le dernier à quitter l'orbite terrestre, et le seul au cours duquel un géologue, Harrison Schmitt, s'est rendu sur la lune. | “                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | Earth - Apollo 17 |
|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Apollo 17 hand-held Hasselblad picture of the full Earth. This picture was taken on 7 December 1972, as the spacecraft traveled to the moon as the last of the Apollo missions. A remarkably cloud-free Africa is at upper left, stretching down to the center of the image. Saudi Arabia is visible at the top of the disk and Antarctica and the south pole are at the bottom. Asia is on the horizon is at upper right. The Earth is 12,740 km (7,920 mi) in diameter. (Apollo 17, AS17-148-22727)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
